text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's rewind a couple days...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sorry, I don't think I heard you right. You're telling me not to pick? That I should run both?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... And you don't just mean junior
year? You want me to run
both dirt and
turf for the whole series?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So... so you're saying it's okay even if I
pick all sorts of races on all
kinds of
tracks?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait, wait! That can't be
possible!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's like booking yourself a one-way
trip on the Orient Express! On
the Titanic! If
we split our efforts in half like that,
we'll just get crummy results in both!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And why's that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because I work twice as...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...I guess I have been doing my due diligence. I give praise at my merch shrine every single day and thank my idols for their blessings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think...
my love of Umas will
pay off?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Have I racked up enough good karma as a
fan? Enough to shine as an
Umamusume
myself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Enough to run wild? On any track I want?!
Even if I'll never be as good
as my oshis,
I'm at least good enough to make it
through the series?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Idol worship tangent aside, I think Agnes
Digital is finally on the same
page as me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
AND IIIIIIIIII WILL ALWAYS LOVE
UUUUMAS!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-anyways! You're right, I did put in
double the effort!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But wow... me, an all-rounder...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaaasdhjk...
It sounds so cool I'm just???
Like, an all-rounder can get
away with
doing literally anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely!
I'll follow fan etiquette to
a tee! No touching or
requests—just look
respectfully! Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I can't believe I'm being rewarded
for all my loyal simping! Even
a lowly
fangirl like me has a place in paradise...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Squee!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, you've won me over! I'll be an
all-rounder! I'll run turf and
dirt and
admire all my oshis up close!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that is why we're at the tryouts, signed up for two races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, looks like I'm up next. Here goes
nothing! If I don't make it
back, tell my
oshis I loved them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Technically, you're only allowed to enter
one tryout race—per track
type.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only thing stopping racers from
entering both is common sense.
It's
unheard of, but I'm sure Agnes Digital can
pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(This track is a sacred place where
countless Umas got their start. I
absolutely
can't do it shame. No...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (A true fan would do it proud! I'll run so beautifully that the track SHINES!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
All racers are in their gates...
and they're
off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(They power through the dirt, beads of
sweat glistening in their wake!
The sheer
ferocity is just. So. Dazzling!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Agnes Digital pushes her way forward!
What a stunning spurt!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (The turf muffles the sound of their footsteps, and I can hear them breathing heavily... Look at how they stretch their legs so elegantly... I've got to get a closer look! They're all so...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They're so unique! I love them ALLLLL!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Agnes Digital tears down the turf
like it's nothing! Have you
ever seen
duality like this?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What on earth?! How is she this good at
both? That racer... She's got
the makings
of a legend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital puts on a performance
greater than I could've dreamed of! As
soon as she crosses the finish line,
I jump to go congratulate
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks a billion! I'm just grateful
that I got to see all my oshis
up close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks to you!
If I didn't have
you stanning with—

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Pardon, I just wanted to congratulate you
on those runs! You had me
baffled,
running dirt and turf like it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwaaagh?! Uh, um!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'd be more than happy to manage your
training plans! We can start with dirt in
junior year to build strength,
then shift to turf for the rest
of—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Um! S-sorry, but... I can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for something more balanced! I
don't want to limit myself
to just one style,
so... I'm going to be an all-rounder! And,
um—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I actually,
uh... I already decided to accept
a scout offer from this
trainer here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: J-just play along! Did you see the way this creep butted into our convo?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thanks. I didn't expect to attract
that much attention. Sorry for
making a
scene.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heheh...
I just said the first thing that
came to mind, sorry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I did mean it, though! As you can probably
tell, I'm not exactly the
best at talking to
people...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But you're as much of an Uma fan as I am,
so I don't have to hold back
like I do with
other trainers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, you're the only one who's
ever respected my interests, and I doubt
I'll find another. So,
please! Would you be my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yessss! Oh,
that's a relief. I can't wait to
get started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume has their own reason to
run. No matter what shape
their dreams
take, I want to help make them shine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, also. I almost forgot to ask.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which color light stick do you want?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're staying to watch the rest of the
tryouts, right? We've gotta
rack up today's
karma points too! C'mon!
